note: Based on current rankings + UFC 333 results

divisions.name: Heavyweight
divisions.analysis: Aspinall’s injury opened the door. Gane is the logical interim/undisputed path; Hokit has the momentum and size. Winner becomes the clear #1 until Aspinall returns.

divisions.name: Light Heavyweight
divisions.next: Alex Pereira vs Magomed Ankalaev 2 or top contender
divisions.analysis: Pereira is still the biggest draw. A clean rematch or a ranked contender (Hill / Ankalaev path) makes sense. Division needs clearer #1 contender ordering.

divisions.name: Middleweight
divisions.next: Dricus du Plessis defense vs Brendan Allen or Khamzat path
divisions.analysis: Allen’s recent form and callouts put him in the conversation. Khamzat remains the dangerous wildcard if healthy. Strickland drama keeps the division noisy.

divisions.name: Welterweight
divisions.next: Islam Makhachev vs Carlos Prates or Michael Morales
divisions.analysis: Islam’s move up is the story. Prates/Morales have been mentioned for an interim if timing doesn’t work for a full title fight.

divisions.name: Lightweight
divisions.next: Ilia Topuria vs Arman Tsarukyan or Justin Gaethje
divisions.analysis: Topuria is the clear champion. Arman has the ranking and style; Gaethje remains the biggest money / BMF-style option.

divisions.name: Featherweight
divisions.analysis: Volk’s dominant UFC 333 defense re-establishes him as the man. Logical next: big-name crossover (Gaethje) or a ranked killer (Lopes / Murphy).

divisions.name: Bantamweight
divisions.next: Petr Yan vs Sean O’Malley or Song Yadong
divisions.analysis: Yan closed the Merab trilogy at UFC 333. O’Malley is the biggest remaining draw; Yadong is the ranked, active threat.

divisions.name: Flyweight
divisions.next: Joshua Van vs Manel Kape or Pantoja path
divisions.analysis: Van is the new champion after a statement run. Kape has the ranking and chaos factor; a Pantoja rubber match still sells.

divisions.name: Women’s Strawweight
divisions.next: Zhang Weili vs Tatiana Suarez or Jandiroba
divisions.analysis: Weili remains the clear #1. Suarez is the ranked wrestler threat; Jandiroba has the experience.

divisions.name: Women’s Flyweight
divisions.next: Valentina Shevchenko vs Natalia Silva or Grasso path
divisions.analysis: Valentina is still the standard. Silva’s recent form makes her a legitimate contender; Grasso trilogy remains the biggest storyline if both sides want it.

divisions.name: Women’s Bantamweight
divisions.next: Joselyne Edwards vs Ailin Perez or Norma Dumont
divisions.analysis: Division is thinner but active. Perez and Dumont are the clearest ranked options right now.
